```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r libraries}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

# Repository root. When knitted, the working directory is the folder containing
# this Rmd (the repo root), so these project-relative paths resolve directly.
BASE_DIR <- getwd()
DATA_DIR <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "Section4/data")
```

```{r load_data}
# Fixed input datasets
datasets <- list(
  Mouse     = file.path(DATA_DIR, "mouse_sr_correlations.rds"),
  LongBench = file.path(DATA_DIR, "longbench_sr_correlations.rds"),
  iNeuron   = file.path(DATA_DIR, "neuron_sr_correlations.rds")
)
```

```{r fit_models}
anova_rows <- list()

for (name in names(datasets)) {
  dat <- readRDS(datasets[[name]])
  dat$Technology <- as.factor(dat$Dataset)
  dat$Technology <- relevel(dat$Technology, ref = 'ont')
  dat$Tool <- as.factor(dat$Tool)
  dat$Tool <- relevel(dat$Tool, ref = 'bambu')
  dat$Normalization <- as.factor(dat$Normalization)
  dat$Normalization <- relevel(dat$Normalization, ref = 'CPM')
  dat$Correlation_z <- atanh(dat$Correlation)

  model <- lmer(Correlation_z ~ Tool * Normalization + Tool * Technology + Normalization * Technology + (1 | Sample), data = dat)

  an <- as.data.frame(anova(model, type = 3))
  an$Factor <- rownames(an)
  an$Dataset <- name

  # Calculate R2 (Nakagawa formulation)
  fix_var <- var(predict(model, re.form = NA))
  vc <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model))
  rand_var <- sum(vc$vcov[vc$grp != "Residual"])
  resid_var <- vc$vcov[vc$grp == "Residual"]
  total_var <- fix_var + rand_var + resid_var

  an$R2_marginal <- round(fix_var / total_var, 4)
  an$R2_conditional <- round((fix_var + rand_var) / total_var, 4)

  # Rename columns properly
  colnames(an)[1:6] <- c("Sum_Sq", "Mean_Sq", "NumDF", "DenDF", "F_value", "P_value")

  anova_rows[[name]] <- an
}

all_anova <- bind_rows(anova_rows)

all_anova <- all_anova %>%
  select(Dataset, Factor, Sum_Sq, Mean_Sq, NumDF, DenDF, F_value, P_value, R2_marginal, R2_conditional)

# Round numeric values for presentation
all_anova$Sum_Sq <- round(all_anova$Sum_Sq, 4)
all_anova$Mean_Sq <- round(all_anova$Mean_Sq, 4)
all_anova$NumDF <- round(all_anova$NumDF, 0)
all_anova$DenDF <- round(all_anova$DenDF, 1)
all_anova$F_value <- round(all_anova$F_value, 2)
all_anova$P_value_formatted <- ifelse(all_anova$P_value < 2.2e-16, "< 2.2e-16", sprintf("%.3e", all_anova$P_value))
```

```{r export}
out_dir <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "manuscript_tables")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
out_path <- file.path(out_dir, "supplementary_table_s4_lmm_anova.csv")
write.csv(all_anova, out_path, row.names = FALSE)
cat('Successfully exported:', out_path, '\n')
```

knitr::kable(all_anova)
